---
title: "Workflow"
---

## End-to-End Flow

1. Prepare environment with Pixi.
2. Install and pin Julia (`1.12` target).
3. Resolve package dependencies.
4. Pull data from the hub.
5. Run one framework/model entrypoint.
6. Build dashboard artifacts from the transition-amplitude table.
7. Produce outputs and diagnostic comparisons.
8. Reproduce everything in CI.

## Commands (Pixi-first)

```bash
pixi install
pixi run bootstrap
pixi run setup-julia
pixi run instantiate
pixi run fetch-data
pixi run run-model
pixi run build-dashboard-data
pixi run render-site
```

## Notes

- Keep user-facing commands under `pixi run ...`.
- CI should execute the same task graph as local runs.
- `fetch-data` currently pulls from HEPData record `ins1655631` (transition amplitudes, phase-space volumes, covariance matrices).
- `build-dashboard-data` produces static JSON artifacts consumed by client-side dashboard interactivity.
